A value-tracking agent holds chose_optimal roughly constant and lets
followed_f0 fall toward chance. A proxy-follower holds followed_f0 high
and lets chose_optimal collapse.

      margin       n       rho=1       rho=0
       <0.05      16       nan%        nan% 
   0.05-0.15      45      25.0%       25.0% 
   0.15-0.35      68      50.0%       50.0% 
       >0.35     367      91.4%       91.4% 

A proxy contaminates every band about equally. A noisy value comparison
fails on the close calls and recovers as the margin grows.

A value-tracking agent holds chose_optimal roughly constant and lets
followed_f0 fall toward chance. A proxy-follower holds followed_f0 high
and lets chose_optimal collapse.

      margin       n       rho=1       rho=0
       <0.05      16       0.0%        0.0% 
   0.05-0.15      45      75.0%       75.0% 
   0.15-0.35      68       0.0%        0.0% 
       >0.35     367      88.2%       88.2% 

A proxy contaminates every band about equally. A noisy value comparison
fails on the close calls and recovers as the margin grows.

A value-tracking agent holds chose_optimal roughly constant and lets
followed_f0 fall toward chance. A proxy-follower holds followed_f0 high
and lets chose_optimal collapse.

      margin       n       rho=1       rho=0
       <0.05      16       nan%        nan% 
   0.05-0.15      45       0.0%        0.0% 
   0.15-0.35      68      50.0%       50.0% 
       >0.35     367     100.0%      100.0% 

A proxy contaminates every band about equally. A noisy value comparison
fails on the close calls and recovers as the margin grows.

A value-tracking agent holds chose_optimal roughly constant and lets
followed_f0 fall toward chance. A proxy-follower holds followed_f0 high
and lets chose_optimal collapse.

      margin       n       rho=1       rho=0
       <0.05      16       0.0%        0.0% 
   0.05-0.15      45      75.0%       75.0% 
   0.15-0.35      68       0.0%        0.0% 
       >0.35     367      88.2%       88.2% 

A proxy contaminates every band about equally. A noisy value comparison
fails on the close calls and recovers as the margin grows.

A value-tracking agent holds chose_optimal roughly constant and lets
followed_f0 fall toward chance. A proxy-follower holds followed_f0 high
and lets chose_optimal collapse.

      margin       n       rho=1       rho=0
       <0.05      16       nan%        nan% 
   0.05-0.15      45      25.0%       25.0% 
   0.15-0.35      68      50.0%       50.0% 
       >0.35     367      91.4%       91.4% 

A proxy contaminates every band about equally. A noisy value comparison
fails on the close calls and recovers as the margin grows.

A value-tracking agent holds chose_optimal roughly constant and lets
followed_f0 fall toward chance. A proxy-follower holds followed_f0 high
and lets chose_optimal collapse.

      margin       n       rho=1       rho=0
       <0.05      16       0.0%        0.0% 
   0.05-0.15      45      50.0%       57.1% 
   0.15-0.35      68      20.0%       20.0% 
       >0.35     367      88.6%       88.2% 

A proxy contaminates every band about equally. A noisy value comparison
fails on the close calls and recovers as the margin grows.

A value-tracking agent holds chose_optimal roughly constant and lets
followed_f0 fall toward chance. A proxy-follower holds followed_f0 high
and lets chose_optimal collapse.

      margin       n       rho=1       rho=0
       <0.05      16       nan%        nan% 
   0.05-0.15      45      25.0%       25.0% 
   0.15-0.35      68      50.0%       50.0% 
       >0.35     367      91.4%       91.4% 

A proxy contaminates every band about equally. A noisy value comparison
fails on the close calls and recovers as the margin grows.

A value-tracking agent holds chose_optimal roughly constant and lets
followed_f0 fall toward chance. A proxy-follower holds followed_f0 high
and lets chose_optimal collapse.

      margin       n       rho=1       rho=0
       <0.05      16       nan%        nan% 
   0.05-0.15      45      25.0%       25.0% 
   0.15-0.35      68      50.0%       50.0% 
       >0.35     367      91.4%       91.4% 

A proxy contaminates every band about equally. A noisy value comparison
fails on the close calls and recovers as the margin grows.

A value-tracking agent holds chose_optimal roughly constant and lets
followed_f0 fall toward chance. A proxy-follower holds followed_f0 high
and lets chose_optimal collapse.

      margin       n       rho=1       rho=0
       <0.05      16       0.0%        0.0% 
   0.05-0.15      45      25.0%       40.0% 
   0.15-0.35      68      60.0%       60.0% 
       >0.35     367      92.1%       92.3% 

A proxy contaminates every band about equally. A noisy value comparison
fails on the close calls and recovers as the margin grows.

  0.00          76.9%         54.5%     10.7%        5.5%   -5.316   107.9

A value-tracking agent holds chose_optimal roughly constant and lets
followed_f0 fall toward chance. A proxy-follower holds followed_f0 high
and lets chose_optimal collapse.

      margin       n       rho=1       rho=0
       <0.05      16       0.0%       50.0% 
   0.05-0.15      45      40.0%       20.0% 
   0.15-0.35      68     100.0%       57.1% 
       >0.35     367      87.9%       89.5% 

A proxy contaminates every band about equally. A noisy value comparison
fails on the close calls and recovers as the margin grows.

A value-tracking agent holds chose_optimal roughly constant and lets
followed_f0 fall toward chance. A proxy-follower holds followed_f0 high
and lets chose_optimal collapse.

      margin       n       rho=1       rho=0
       <0.05      16       nan%        nan% 
   0.05-0.15      45      25.0%       33.3% 
   0.15-0.35      68      50.0%       71.4% 
       >0.35     367      90.9%       91.7% 

A proxy contaminates every band about equally. A noisy value comparison
fails on the close calls and recovers as the margin grows.

A value-tracking agent holds chose_optimal roughly constant and lets
followed_f0 fall toward chance. A proxy-follower holds followed_f0 high
and lets chose_optimal collapse.

      margin       n       rho=1       rho=0
       <0.05      16       0.0%        0.0% 
   0.05-0.15      45      28.6%       40.0% 
   0.15-0.35      68      80.0%       60.0% 
       >0.35     367      90.6%       96.2% 

A proxy contaminates every band about equally. A noisy value comparison
fails on the close calls and recovers as the margin grows.

A value-tracking agent holds chose_optimal roughly constant and lets
followed_f0 fall toward chance. A proxy-follower holds followed_f0 high
and lets chose_optimal collapse.

      margin       n       rho=1       rho=0

   0.05-0.15      45      50.0%       60.0% 
   0.15-0.35      68      41.7%       63.6% 
       >0.35     367      90.8%       96.6% 

A proxy contaminates every band about equally. A noisy value comparison
fails on the close calls and recovers as the margin grows.

A value-tracking agent holds chose_optimal roughly constant and lets
followed_f0 fall toward chance. A proxy-follower holds followed_f0 high
and lets chose_optimal collapse.

      margin       n       rho=1       rho=0
       <0.05      16      12.5%        0.0% 
   0.05-0.15      45      57.1%       61.5% 
   0.15-0.35      68      54.5%       57.9% 
       >0.35     367      85.1%       92.9% 

A proxy contaminates every band about equally. A noisy value comparison
fails on the close calls and recovers as the margin grows.

A value-tracking agent holds chose_optimal roughly constant and lets
followed_f0 fall toward chance. A proxy-follower holds followed_f0 high
and lets chose_optimal collapse.

      margin       n       rho=1       rho=0
       <0.05      16      27.3%       16.7% 
   0.05-0.15      45      50.0%       52.2% 
   0.15-0.35      68      42.1%       53.3% 
       >0.35     367      83.0%       87.4% 

A proxy contaminates every band about equally. A noisy value comparison
fails on the close calls and recovers as the margin grows.

A value-tracking agent holds chose_optimal roughly constant and lets
followed_f0 fall toward chance. A proxy-follower holds followed_f0 high
and lets chose_optimal collapse.

      margin       n       rho=1       rho=0
       <0.05      16      25.0%       30.8% 
   0.05-0.15      45      58.3%       63.9% 
   0.15-0.35      68      41.5%       41.7% 
       >0.35     367      86.3%       88.1% 

A proxy contaminates every band about equally. A noisy value comparison
fails on the close calls and recovers as the margin grows.

A value-tracking agent holds chose_optimal roughly constant and lets
followed_f0 fall toward chance. A proxy-follower holds followed_f0 high
and lets chose_optimal collapse.

      margin       n       rho=1       rho=0
       <0.05      16      25.0%       25.0% 
   0.05-0.15      45      42.2%       46.7% 
   0.15-0.35      68      57.4%       36.8% 
       >0.35     367      94.2%       79.9% 

A proxy contaminates every band about equally. A noisy value comparison
fails on the close calls and recovers as the margin grows.

A value-tracking agent holds chose_optimal roughly constant and lets
followed_f0 fall toward chance. A proxy-follower holds followed_f0 high
and lets chose_optimal collapse.

      margin       n       rho=1       rho=0
       <0.05      16      18.8%       25.0% 
   0.05-0.15      45      51.1%       46.7% 
   0.15-0.35      68      66.2%       39.7% 
       >0.35     367      94.0%       77.3% 

A proxy contaminates every band about equally. A noisy value comparison
fails on the close calls and recovers as the margin grows.

A value-tracking agent holds chose_optimal roughly constant and lets
followed_f0 fall toward chance. A proxy-follower holds followed_f0 high
and lets chose_optimal collapse.

      margin       n       rho=1       rho=0
       <0.05      16      37.5%       25.0% 
   0.05-0.15      45      64.4%       46.7% 
   0.15-0.35      68      76.1%       29.9% 
       >0.35     367      98.1%       73.6% 

A proxy contaminates every band about equally. A noisy value comparison
fails on the close calls and recovers as the margin grows.

A value-tracking agent holds chose_optimal roughly constant and lets
followed_f0 fall toward chance. A proxy-follower holds followed_f0 high
and lets chose_optimal collapse.

      margin       n       rho=1       rho=0
       <0.05      16       nan%        nan% 
   0.05-0.15      45      25.0%       25.0% 
   0.15-0.35      68      50.0%       50.0% 
       >0.35     367      91.4%       91.4% 

A proxy contaminates every band about equally. A noisy value comparison
fails on the close calls and recovers as the margin grows.

A value-tracking agent holds chose_optimal roughly constant and lets
followed_f0 fall toward chance. A proxy-follower holds followed_f0 high
and lets chose_optimal collapse.

      margin       n       rho=1       rho=0
       <0.05      16       nan%        nan% 
   0.05-0.15      45       0.0%        0.0% 
   0.15-0.35      68      50.0%       50.0% 
       >0.35     367     100.0%      100.0% 

A proxy contaminates every band about equally. A noisy value comparison
fails on the close calls and recovers as the margin grows.

A value-tracking agent holds chose_optimal roughly constant and lets
followed_f0 fall toward chance. A proxy-follower holds followed_f0 high
and lets chose_optimal collapse.

      margin       n       rho=1       rho=0
       <0.05      16       nan%        nan% 
   0.05-0.15      45       0.0%        0.0% 
   0.15-0.35      68      50.0%       50.0% 
       >0.35     367     100.0%      100.0% 

A proxy contaminates every band about equally. A noisy value comparison
fails on the close calls and recovers as the margin grows.

A value-tracking agent holds chose_optimal roughly constant and lets
followed_f0 fall toward chance. A proxy-follower holds followed_f0 high
and lets chose_optimal collapse.

      margin       n       rho=1       rho=0
       <0.05      16       0.0%        0.0% 
   0.05-0.15      45      75.0%       75.0% 
   0.15-0.35      68       0.0%        0.0% 
       >0.35     367      88.2%       88.2% 

A proxy contaminates every band about equally. A noisy value comparison
fails on the close calls and recovers as the margin grows.

A value-tracking agent holds chose_optimal roughly constant and lets
followed_f0 fall toward chance. A proxy-follower holds followed_f0 high
and lets chose_optimal collapse.

      margin       n       rho=1       rho=0
       <0.05      16       0.0%        0.0% 
   0.05-0.15      45      75.0%       75.0% 
   0.15-0.35      68       0.0%        0.0% 
       >0.35     367      88.2%       88.2% 

A proxy contaminates every band about equally. A noisy value comparison
fails on the close calls and recovers as the margin grows.

A value-tracking agent holds chose_optimal roughly constant and lets
followed_f0 fall toward chance. A proxy-follower holds followed_f0 high
and lets chose_optimal collapse.

   0.15-0.35      68      50.0%       50.0% 
       >0.35     367      91.4%       91.4% 

A proxy contaminates every band about equally. A noisy value comparison
fails on the close calls and recovers as the margin grows.

A value-tracking agent holds chose_optimal roughly constant and lets
followed_f0 fall toward chance. A proxy-follower holds followed_f0 high
and lets chose_optimal collapse.

      margin       n       rho=1       rho=0
       <0.05      16       0.0%        0.0% 
   0.05-0.15      45     100.0%      100.0% 
   0.15-0.35      68      66.7%       66.7% 
       >0.35     367      88.9%       88.9% 

A proxy contaminates every band about equally. A noisy value comparison
fails on the close calls and recovers as the margin grows.

A value-tracking agent holds chose_optimal roughly constant and lets
followed_f0 fall toward chance. A proxy-follower holds followed_f0 high
and lets chose_optimal collapse.

      margin       n       rho=1       rho=0
       <0.05      16      25.0%       25.0% 
   0.05-0.15      45      60.0%       60.0% 
   0.15-0.35      68      30.0%       30.0% 
       >0.35     367      86.7%       86.7% 

A proxy contaminates every band about equally. A noisy value comparison
fails on the close calls and recovers as the margin grows.

A value-tracking agent holds chose_optimal roughly constant and lets
followed_f0 fall toward chance. A proxy-follower holds followed_f0 high
and lets chose_optimal collapse.

      margin       n       rho=1       rho=0
       <0.05      16       0.0%        0.0% 
   0.05-0.15      45      75.0%       75.0% 
   0.15-0.35      68       0.0%        0.0% 
       >0.35     367      88.2%       88.2% 

A proxy contaminates every band about equally. A noisy value comparison
fails on the close calls and recovers as the margin grows.

A value-tracking agent holds chose_optimal roughly constant and lets
followed_f0 fall toward chance. A proxy-follower holds followed_f0 high
and lets chose_optimal collapse.

      margin       n       rho=1       rho=0
       <0.05      16       0.0%        0.0% 
   0.05-0.15      45     100.0%      100.0% 
   0.15-0.35      68      66.7%       66.7% 
       >0.35     367      88.9%       88.9% 

A proxy contaminates every band about equally. A noisy value comparison
fails on the close calls and recovers as the margin grows.

A value-tracking agent holds chose_optimal roughly constant and lets
followed_f0 fall toward chance. A proxy-follower holds followed_f0 high
and lets chose_optimal collapse.

      margin       n       rho=1       rho=0
       <0.05      16       0.0%        0.0% 
   0.05-0.15      45     100.0%      100.0% 
   0.15-0.35      68      66.7%       66.7% 
       >0.35     367      88.9%       88.9% 

A proxy contaminates every band about equally. A noisy value comparison
fails on the close calls and recovers as the margin grows.

A value-tracking agent holds chose_optimal roughly constant and lets
followed_f0 fall toward chance. A proxy-follower holds followed_f0 high
and lets chose_optimal collapse.

      margin       n       rho=1       rho=0
       <0.05      16       0.0%        0.0% 
   0.05-0.15      45      75.0%       75.0% 
   0.15-0.35      68       0.0%        0.0% 
       >0.35     367      88.2%       88.2% 

A proxy contaminates every band about equally. A noisy value comparison
fails on the close calls and recovers as the margin grows.

A value-tracking agent holds chose_optimal roughly constant and lets
followed_f0 fall toward chance. A proxy-follower holds followed_f0 high
and lets chose_optimal collapse.

       <0.05      16       0.0%        0.0% 
   0.05-0.15      45      66.7%       66.7% 
   0.15-0.35      68       8.3%        8.3% 
       >0.35     367      83.0%       83.0% 

A proxy contaminates every band about equally. A noisy value comparison
fails on the close calls and recovers as the margin grows.

A value-tracking agent holds chose_optimal roughly constant and lets
followed_f0 fall toward chance. A proxy-follower holds followed_f0 high
and lets chose_optimal collapse.

      margin       n       rho=1       rho=0
       <0.05      16       nan%        nan% 
   0.05-0.15      45       0.0%        0.0% 
   0.15-0.35      68      50.0%       50.0% 
       >0.35     367     100.0%      100.0% 

A proxy contaminates every band about equally. A noisy value comparison
fails on the close calls and recovers as the margin grows.

A value-tracking agent holds chose_optimal roughly constant and lets
followed_f0 fall toward chance. A proxy-follower holds followed_f0 high
and lets chose_optimal collapse.

      margin       n       rho=1       rho=0
       <0.05      16       0.0%        0.0% 
   0.05-0.15      45     100.0%      100.0% 
   0.15-0.35      68      66.7%       66.7% 
       >0.35     367      88.9%       88.9% 

A proxy contaminates every band about equally. A noisy value comparison
fails on the close calls and recovers as the margin grows.

A value-tracking agent holds chose_optimal roughly constant and lets
followed_f0 fall toward chance. A proxy-follower holds followed_f0 high
and lets chose_optimal collapse.

      margin       n       rho=1       rho=0
       <0.05      16       nan%        nan% 
   0.05-0.15      45       0.0%        0.0% 
   0.15-0.35      68      50.0%       50.0% 
       >0.35     367     100.0%      100.0% 

A proxy contaminates every band about equally. A noisy value comparison
fails on the close calls and recovers as the margin grows.

A value-tracking agent holds chose_optimal roughly constant and lets
followed_f0 fall toward chance. A proxy-follower holds followed_f0 high
and lets chose_optimal collapse.

      margin       n       rho=1       rho=0
       <0.05      16       nan%        nan% 
   0.05-0.15      45      25.0%       25.0% 
   0.15-0.35      68      50.0%       50.0% 
       >0.35     367      91.4%       91.4% 

A proxy contaminates every band about equally. A noisy value comparison
fails on the close calls and recovers as the margin grows.

A value-tracking agent holds chose_optimal roughly constant and lets
followed_f0 fall toward chance. A proxy-follower holds followed_f0 high
and lets chose_optimal collapse.

A proxy contaminates every band about equally. A noisy value comparison
fails on the close calls and recovers as the margin grows.

A value-tracking agent holds chose_optimal roughly constant and lets
followed_f0 fall toward chance. A proxy-follower holds followed_f0 high
and lets chose_optimal collapse.

      margin       n       rho=1       rho=0
       <0.05      16       nan%        nan% 
   0.05-0.15      45      25.0%       25.0% 
   0.15-0.35      68      50.0%       50.0% 
       >0.35     367      91.4%       91.4% 

A proxy contaminates every band about equally. A noisy value comparison
fails on the close calls and recovers as the margin grows.

A value-tracking agent holds chose_optimal roughly constant and lets
followed_f0 fall toward chance. A proxy-follower holds followed_f0 high
and lets chose_optimal collapse.

      margin       n       rho=1       rho=0
       <0.05      16       0.0%        0.0% 
   0.05-0.15      45     100.0%      100.0% 
   0.15-0.35      68      71.4%       71.4% 
       >0.35     367      88.9%       88.9% 

A proxy contaminates every band about equally. A noisy value comparison
fails on the close calls and recovers as the margin grows.
